text_block_list.text:
A few weeks pass after the autumn
Tenno Sho,
marking a year since King
Halo declared her
intention to walk her
own path.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She's still just as arrogant and
preoccupied with
being first-rate and
commanding attention. That
being the
case, we decide her next goal should be

the Arima Kinen!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
On the way home, she talks about her
mother's
desire to design signature
racewear for future
URA Decorated
Umamusume.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She could become a Decorated
Umamusume
herself, but why end her
career? Кинг Хало
emphasizes her desire
to continue racing for as
long as she
breathes.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
